rationale.text: A span with role="link" and a script that navigates on click has no content and no attribute name. The glossary counts a tag with role link as a link only when a script handles its navigation, which code cannot establish. The custom check answers cannot_tell for an element with role link whose content gives no name (step 5); only the record supports this branch. axe's link-name does not examine this element and reports no fault, so the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: Balise possédant un attribut WAI-ARIA role="link" et dont l’action de navigation est prise en charge par un script.
Pour chaque lien, vérifier que le contenu de l’élément `<a>` (ou d’un élément pourvu d’un attribut WAI-ARIA `role=link`) contient un intitulé (texte ou alternative)
